list.d: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin Drake.

An elegant fin taken from a defeated Xuanwen Beast's back.
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.

The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.

It is said that there was a great tree whose roots once spread out to every corner of the world, and this branch is said to be part of it. It is almost if it was never broken off and taken far away, for its vitality is such that it still sprouts new leaves even now.
The marked shell of a Consecrated Beast inscribed with ancient script.
A rare bundle of Mist Grass that gives off a faint glow. Those who carry it invite both the Cicins and misfortune.

A prism that can bend light.
A giant piece of bone that glows coldly, taken from the exterior of a glowing beast.
An exquisite component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.
Body tissue left behind by a Fungus that has been exposed to intense elemental stimulation.
An obsidian talisman that houses a Wayob Manifestation.
A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.

A metallic monster horn that can only be obtained from especially strong hilichurls, since blowing on the horn takes real strength.
Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin machine.
Comes from ancient defunct relic structures. Was once a logic circuit responsible for movement functions. Sadly, no one is able to make sense of how it worked.

Body tissue left behind by one of the Riftwolves.
A prism that can bend light.

An idol made in the likeness of some unknown, one-eyed person.
A twig from deep within the earth. Though it is far from where it once lay, its leaves still pulsate with energy.
A component taken from within a defeated ancient machine that had wandered the lunar surface. It seems unlike the metals commonly found in Teyvat.
src: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network

A scroll inscribed with ancient images. It is said that few can decipher its meaning, and the few scholars that have all went mad.
A shard left by Breacher Primus.
The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.
A warrant issued to members of the Fatui Oprichniki.
A chunk taken from the horned crown of a defeated Frostnight Scion.
A faintly glowing piece of bone taken from the exterior of a glowing beast.

A raven insignia that symbolizes the pride and the guiding principle of the Treasure Hoarders. Whether it's hidden amidst the vastness of the land or in the depths of the seas, as long as there are treasures to be hunted down, the spirit of Treasure Hoarders, who will stop at nothing to acquire them, will never die.
A condensed pile of burning matter obtained from the body of a defeated Avatar of Lava.
src: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Avatars of Lava

src: Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 60+ Fatui Agents

list.d: A jade idol that houses a Wayob Manifestation.

Well-preserved Mist Grass. Some would take advantage of the Cicins' love for the Mist Grass to control them.

list.d: A plate found in the mists of the Wild Hunt.
src: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Wasteland Wild Hunt

The drive shaft of a Landcruiser refined by the Design Bureau.
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.

Among Natlan's tribes, this is the symbol of a mighty, Saurian-Crowned warrior.

An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.

list.d: A fragment that houses a Wayob Manifestation.
A well-made arrowhead. Sharp enough to penetrate armor with the ease of a rock through the surface of water.
Nectar that is full of pure elemental energy.

A raven insignia used by members of the Treasure Hoarders to identify each other. The Treasure Hoarders ask for no resume. Anyone who has an insatiable desire for treasure and is backed up by an equal amount of courage can become a worthy member.
Mildly purified slime secretions. Harmful to the skin. Please avoid direct exposure.
An energy core that allows the Specters to float.
A bone mask, covered in unidentifiable stains, that emanates a mysterious odor.

A tooth that fell from a Natlan Saurian.
Clockwork meka's gear.
A battle-worn handguard that was once mounted on an Inazuman blade.
An insignia to identify the recruits. Makes one wonder about what the ones joining the Fatui's war machine were thinking.

This core can power the inorganic Maguu Kenki and cause it to wield a blade like a living being.

list.d: A motive device obtained from a mysterious ruin machine.
The core that powers the autonomous movements of the Perpetual Mechanical Array.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Perpetual Mechanical Arrays

list.d: A fallen feather gathered from a corner of the mortal realm after defeating a Fallen Watcher.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Watchers: Fallen Vigil

list.d: A stamping die taken from the wreckage of a defeated Knuckle Duckle — think of it as a keepsake from Aino.
A crystallized tail vertebra left behind by a defeated Radiant Moongecko in its attempt to escape.
The pale wing-sheathes hiding in a Wenut's tail are as thin as the blooming stamens of a flower.
The final coalesced form of the Dendro Hypostasis. The tough vines protect a pure cubic elemental crystal.
A fragment of a defeated Frostnight Herra's majestic antlers. Light and razor-sharp, it requires no sharpening to help it slice through metal armor with ease.
A deep-black bone relic taken from the lingering corruption left behind after defeating the Whisperer of Nightmares that came invading from beyond this world.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Lords of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares

list.d: A broken horn that you obtained from defeating the Wolflord. That said, it should not have left anything behind after your hunt.
A "fang" with which the mysterious, snakelike machine of old dug into mountains' depths. There are many ominous runes carved on it.
A special structure removed from a dragon-headed Source Mechanism. It is no longer active.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device

list.d: The tail feather of a powerful chimeric monster.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Chimeric Winged Lions

list.d: A crystallization of a Pyro Hypostasis that constantly emits heat.
A core pulled from the blazing remains of the Lava Dragon Statue.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Lava Dragon Statues

list.d: Crackling Electro pearls left behind by the Thunder Manifestation.
A talisman that somehow appeared in your inventory after you passed the Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker's test.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeakers

list.d: The core of an Electro Regisvine, wrapped in razor-sharp leaves, wantonly emits Electro energy.
A blossom branch taken from a monster created by someone to serve their selfish desires. It won't wither or burn in flame.
An ancient piece of Snegovik armor with cracks all over it.
src: Dropped by Lv. 30+ Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow

list.d: The only remnants of Hydro Tulpas after their parts are dispersed.

An item capable of changing Character Level-Up Materials obtained from memories and trials into whatever form is needed.
src: Trounce Domain and Great Wolf King of the North Challenge Reward

list.d: A conch-like structure that gives off a faint glow. Despite the name, it is not a shell but something condensed from pure elemental energy.
A clear and clean azure flower, it is born where Water Veins come together. It has a simple, cool, and elegant fragrance, pungent and refreshing yet gentle.
A serene and tranquil violet flower. It has a light, soft, and lasting scent and is often used for making luxurious perfumes.
src: Found in the north of the Court of Fontaine

list.d: A soft-bodied animal that emits a gentle light. Often found climbing the walls of buildings near the water or underwater.
A delicate and tender pink flower. Despite their name, Rainbow Roses are essentially more akin to Lilies.
An ethereal and elegant blue flower. Its tender petals are elastic and water-absorbent, making it the ideal raw material for various daily necessities.
A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.
src: Recommendation: Found underwater in Morte Region

list.d: Detection units produced by Fontaine Research Institute using new models of artificed components. Its original purpose was monitoring all kinds of environmental data.
src: Recommendation: Found in Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region

list.d: The fruit of the Amakumo Grass, which grows on Seirai Island. You can hear it crackling with a tiny current if you hold it up to your ear.
A crystal that contains a sliver of Tatarigami power. Adding this material during smelting will greatly increase the strength and toughness of metals.

A vibrant plant that has also been named the "lycoris" by the poets. It was once thought extinct in the Inazuman archipelago, only to re-emerge now upon the battlefields. It is said that it blooms most enchantingly where much blood was spilled.
A mushroom that glows like a night-light. Some curious power lies hidden within it.
Even on windless days, this plant will tremble lightly amid the cries of thunder. The parts of it that resemble petals are in fact extensions of the leaves meant to protect the fragile flower.
A strange beetle that inhabits areas rich with Electro energy. Its docile and sedentary temperament could not be more different from the fierce, demonic visage displayed on its armored shell.
Blossoms from the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine, filled with a fondness for Inazuma.
A precious pearl that grows in the coral of Watatsumi. Gives off a cool sheen like that of the moonlight.
A plant species that only grows in certain regions and islands of the ocean. Though it looks like a fungus of some sort, it actually comes from a substance secreted by certain soft-bodied organisms.
Jade from Chenyu Vale. Named for its cool, refreshing touch, that is much like clear water.
src: Recommendation: Found in Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain

list.d: A precious crystal of condensed pure Geo element that usually grows along with other minerals. It's also commonly called "Cor Petrae."
An extremely ancient flower that was said to be commonly seen in Liyue. It transforms the memories of the land into its fragrance during florescence.
src: Recommendation: Found in Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

list.d: A spicy plant native to Liyue. Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.
A rare mineral that glimmers in the dark. It's said to be a mutated gemstone condensed from the flourishing elements of the world.
A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.
src: Recommendation: Found in Guyun Stone Forest

list.d: A crimson flower that blooms like the rainbow clouds in Liyue. It can be made into silky-smooth fabric.
src: Found near Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

list.d: Empty seashells brought ashore by the tides. Hold one close to your ear, and hear the longing calls of the sea.
src: Found on the beaches of Liyue

list.d: A small flower with strong vitality. It is said that its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.
A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.
A beautiful flower with a name that suits its appearance. It only grows where harsh winds blow, and is just as intangible as the true heart of an unbound soul.
A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.
A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.
src: Recommendation: Found on Windrest Peak and Temple of Space
Recommendation: Found in Millhaven and the Pillar Hall Central Zone

list.d: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.
src: Found under the eaves of houses

list.d: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.
src: Recommendation: Found in the Whispering Woods

list.d: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.
A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."
src: Found near the Statue of The Seven at Windrise

list.d: A berry with thorns that often gets attached to a wolf's pelt. When you look at it, you can almost hear the echoing cries of the wolves in the woods.
A flower with a shape like floating wings. Its petals sway in an unbelievably relaxed, serene manner as they are caressed by the wind.
src: Recommendation: Found near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

list.d: Formed gradually in areas rich in Phlogiston, these red, scale-like crystals are blazing-hot to the touch.
A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.
src: Recommendation: Found near the "Masters of the Night-Wind"

list.d: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.
src: Recommendation: Found below the "Scions of the Canopy"

list.d: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.
src: Recommendation: Found in the Sulfurous Veins

list.d: A strange plant whose flower's exterior resembles stone. Only in bloom does it reveal a resplendent, crystal-like core.
A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.
src: Recommendation: Found near the "People of the Springs"

list.d: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.
A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.
src: Recommendation: Found in the Final Night Cemetery
Recommendation: Found near the Frostmoon Enclave

list.d: A silver crystal as pure and pristine as moonlight. It possesses almost perfect elemental affinity.
A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.
src: Recommendation: Found near the Favonius Keep

list.d: A portable bearing of a type that was mass-produced after the Fatui moved into Nod-Krai. Excessively worn units are discarded like obsolete personnel.
src: Recommendation: Found at the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

list.d: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.
src: Found at the Pillar of Embla

list.d: A peculiar plant once suspected to be a hybrid of plant and animal, though it was later proven to be nothing more than an ordinary plant covered in a coat of animal-like fuzz.
A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.
src: Recommendation: Found in White Birch Snowgrave

list.d: A fern whose edges radiate a faint golden shimmer. It is said to take on a remarkably unique flavor when stewed.
A fruit that grows even in the most hostile of desert environments. Its vibrant crimson fruits are made even more lovely against a backdrop of yellow sand.
src: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

list.d: Flowers from vines that grow on cliff sides. It is called a lotus only because it has a similar appearance to one. Aside from that, it bears no other similar properties to the lotus.
src: Found in the mountains of Sumeru

list.d: Crimson flowers that bloom on ancient battlefields. They can even flourish in the depths of the desert. Their drooping flowers seem to be in mourning for heroes long past.
src: Found in the deserts of Sumeru
Recommendation: Found in the Asipattravana Swamp

list.d: Growing in the forest wetlands, these plants only bloom at night with flowers as bright as the moon.
src: Found at water bodies in Sumeru

list.d: A holy and noble plant. The conditions for growth in its environment are very demanding. The flower buds can be processed to make valuable spices.
A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest.
src: Recommendation: Found in the Ashavan Realm

list.d: You can only find such husks deep in the desert where the Quicksand Eels breed. The hardened shell is meant to protect the Quicksand Eels' larval bodies until they finally acclimate to the conditions of the dry desert.
src: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

list.d: A tenacious beetle that finds repose within the vast ocean of desert sand. The golden pattern on such beetles' shells hints at some deep relationship between them and the ancient ruins that dot the desert.
src: Found in the desert ruins of Sumeru

list.d: A splendorous stone that can be found in the depths of desolate mountains, seemingly formed from congealed elemental energy.
src: Found in the deserts of Sumeru
